name: smwgraphics-five-nights-at-freddy-s-plushies
title: Five Nights at Freddy's - Plushies
description:
The plushies of the original FNaF 1 animatronics (Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy and Golden Freddy), to be used as decoration.

Note: Chica doesn't have her cupcake. Also, if you're gonna use Foxy, you won't be able to use green berries.
